rows.source_location: Abstract; slides 'LUCI: SIBAL fabric' and 'LUCI: SIBAL fabric' (O2 plot)
rows.quote: Two samples are burned simultaneously in air at normal pressure ... SIBAL fabric (cotton-fiberglass blend) burning downward in Lunar-g ... Spread rates for char front, flame base, and flame tip are all linear (steady state spread) ... O2 concentration decreases from ~20% to ~18%.
rows.notes: O2 taken as the stated starting value (~20%); 'normal pressure' taken as 101.3 kPa; g = (11 RPM)^2 x 1.22 m = 1.62 m/s^2 = 0.165 g (computed from the stated rotation). The burn ended in extinction but the O2 at extinction is only given approximately, so no extinction row was added.
